info.name: CosmicForge Real Estate
info.description: Official human-facing API handoff collection for CosmicForge Real Estate. OpenAPI remains the machine-readable contract. Requests are added only when the matching backend endpoint is implemented.

item.name: 00 Platform
item.description: Gateway/platform health, readiness and version endpoints. Edge behaviour common to all APIs: errors use the platform envelope (see examples), X-Request-ID is echoed, 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED / INVALID_TOKEN, 403 PERMISSION_DENIED for a token from another product, 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After, 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND (including any /internal path).

request.description: Liveness of the API Gateway. No authentication.
Readiness of the API Gateway; 503 while draining for shutdown.
Build metadata of the deployed gateway image.

item.name: 01 Marketplace
item.description: Frontend-facing Marketplace APIs.

item.name: 02 Individual Owner
item.description: Individual Owner (individual-owner-service). Frontend requests go through the gateway with {{individual_owner_token}}; _Internal and _Admin requests call the service directly with a service JWT ({{service_token}}). Implemented: Section 5 account security (Frontend, _Admin) and the Sections 6–13 domain API generated from the route registry (profile, banking & tax, properties, ownership & verification and later contexts). Features whose dependency is not configured answer 503 FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE. Runtime integrations remain unavailable unless implemented and independently certified: real CF Meet, e-sign, external calendar/listing sync, physical smart devices, maps/geocoding, licensed financing/insurance and future Marketplace/Manager/Artisan/Professional services. Financial Core contracts do not approve custody, escrow, DVA or transfers.
